system.description:
Like a tidal surge, you overwhelm enemies through relentless movement. This form teaches that power lies not in the blow, but in the rhythm that leads to it.

You surge forward in rolling attacks. Whilst in this form, you gain the following modifiers:

  • When you move 10+ feet before attacking, gain +1 attack bonus and +Int mod to damage.
  • On a Critical hit, you may push the target 5 feet (Fort negates).

Automated: press Combat Form's Use to enter it (1 AP, a stance). the +1 attack and +Int damage are offered as tick-boxes (you moved 10 feet). On a critical the card offers the push: a Fortitude save against your Technique DC (10 + Int + level) negates. All its modifiers are class bonuses.

conditionals.label: Crashing Tide
conditionals.scope: You moved 10 feet or more before this attack — tick if so
